transport.bpmHint: Drag up/down or use the mouse wheel

view.title: View: level and language
view.beginnerHint: Explains functions in words and labels every note.
view.intermediateHint: Shows names and Roman numerals together.
view.advancedHint: Compact interface; adds each chord's numeric tension.

key.title: Key
key.rotate: Turn the outer ring to change key

wheel.title: Harmony wheel
wheel.hint: Hover to listen · click to add · drag onto the ribbon

reason.sameRoot: Same root: the color changes, not the function.
reason.fromTonic: From the tonic you can go anywhere.
reason.fifthDown: The root falls a fifth: the strongest move in harmony.
reason.susResolution: The suspended note resolves by step.
reason.preparedSus: The suspended note was already sounding: a prepared suspension.
reason.weak: No tonal rule backs this step; it may sound surprising.

ribbon.empty: Drag chords from the wheel or click one to start
ribbon.resize: Drag the edge to change the length

sections.name: Section name
sections.keyHint: A section with its own key is a modulation: the wheel and piano roll adapt.

timeline.rulerHint: Click: move the playhead · Drag: set the loop region

file.discardQuestion: There are unsaved changes. Discard them?
file.autosaveNote: Tonalia keeps an automatic copy: if you close the app, your song waits for you.

tips.hint: 💡 Right-click chords, functions, modes or the wheel to learn what they convey and when to use them.

tracks.emptyHint: No notes yet: click to open the piano roll and draw a melody

engine.title: Sound
engine.hint: Sampled: real recordings (GeneralUser GS). Synth: light FM sound.

piano.drawHint: Click and drag to create notes · right-click deletes
piano.velocityHint: Drag a note up/down to change its velocity
